answer: An agent registers by locking a fixed native-token bond as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught signing two conflicting attestations in one epoch is exposed by comparing signatures on the ledger. Conviction means the entire bond is destroyed at once. The ledger keeps every bond inside a quill the owner cannot hide. No lotus hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The terrace keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
